description: NEGATIVE CONTROL (must FAIL). Proves the wall-clock guard has discriminating power: a workload that stalls far beyond its predeclared per-case timeout is judged FAIL (exit code 1) instead of hanging the unattended runner. The second case is deliberately healthy, so a green run here would mean either the guard is vacuous or the healthy case was silently dropped.

cases.title: stalling workload (30 s) against a 0.5 s predeclared timeout: must be FAIL, not a hang
healthy case that must still run after the stalled one was cut off (no collateral skip)
